🚂 Good news for Preston — with a catch.

The Lancashire Combined County Authority has approved £28.2m towards Cottam Parkway railway station, on top of £28.4m already committed by the Department for Transport. It will serve around 17,000 households in Cottam and Lea, with roughly 644,000 passenger journeys a year expected.

I'm not going to sneer at money coming into Preston. I'll take it. But the bill has climbed past £55m, largely on inflation caused by the delay itself — and the provisional opening date is December 2030. Four years, for a platform on an existing line. 👇
